entities.name: Archie Dixon
entities.description: Punctual freelance human courier in Omenport on Thunder Junction, killed delivering a sack for the Sterling Company.

entities.name: Omenport
entities.description: Town where Archie lived and worked.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: Hired Archie to transport a burlap sack.

entities.name: Hellspurs
entities.description: Group led by Akul that ambushed Archie's carriage.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: Fearsome scorpion dragon leading the Hellspurs.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: Man who used Archie as a dupe.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths whose opening brought Archie to Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Archie was hired by the Sterling Company to carry a mysterious burlap sack across Thunder Junction.
events.quote: He was hired by the Sterling Company to transport a mysterious burlap sack across Thunder Junction

events.summary: Hellspurs led by Akul ambushed the carriage, killing the guards and mortally wounding Archie.
events.quote: killing the guards and leaving Archie mortally wounded

events.summary: Akul seized the sack and found only lumps of coal.
events.quote: Akul seized it, only to discover it contained nothing but lumps of coal

events.summary: Archie died in the broken carriage, realizing Bertram Graywater had used him as a dupe.
events.quote: realizing he had been used as a dupe by Bertram Graywater
